items.title: Show HN: Yantra – an LALR(1) parser generator for C++
items.contentSnippet:
Yantra is a C++ parser generator: lexer, parser, and AST walker all generated from one tool.
It builds the whole AST first, then walks it.
Most LALR parser generators (Yacc, Bison, Lemon) run your semantic actions during parsing, as each rule reduces, bottom-up.

Smartly turns plain English into shell commands, using your OS, current directory, and Git context to help produce something relevant to where you’re working. items.contentSnippet:
I built birthdaytraffic.com to answer one question: How rare is your birthday, really?! You pick a date and it shows your rank compared to everyone else. You can also explore other birthdays (and make your own conclusions about the events that conspired nine months earlier...)
Over 33,000 people tried it in its first week and I've been deep in the birthday universe since then. Feel free to ask any questions! :)

decoding a JWT some endpoint returned, cleaning up Base64 hashes,
